aboutCards.content:
I am a Computer Engineering graduate with experience in building scalable applications across mobile, web, and backend systems. I specialize in Flutter for cross-platform development and NestJS for backend services, with strong expertise in REST API integration and real-time features. I enjoy turning ideas into functional products, writing clean and maintainable code, and continuously improving system performance, with experience spanning production applications, machine learning projects, and IoT-based solutions.

Outside of work, I enjoy watching movies and listening to music as a way to relax and recharge. I also like staying active through sports, and occasionally spend my free time playing games with friends.
